text:
eli: Quick heads-up — after deploying role-normalize-3 some org-admins can't rotate service account keys in the Console. Clicking Rotate shows 403 even though API says they're admin. Repro below. :thinking:

mona: Which deploy tag? Is this org-wide or a subset? @hugo can you triage?

eli: Deploy: role-normalize-3 (deploy-bot announced it). Example: user u_admin42 on org-321, project p_infra_7. Console: Rotate button -> 403. API calls: `GET /api/v1/orgs/org-321/permissions?user=u_admin42` -> `{ "user":"u_admin42", "role":"admin", "permissions": ["org:manage","keys:rotate"] }` but `GET /api/v1/projects/p_infra_7/permissions?user=u_admin42` -> `{ "user":"u_admin42", "role": null, "permissions": [] }` so UI hides the button based on project check.

hugo: Hmm. Different from the usual "missing billing" cases — the migrator changed how encrypted role_aliases are looked up. We rotated a KMS key last week (`keyRbac` -> `key-rbac-v2`) and the migrator includes alias decryption. Check migrator run and KMS logs.

kms-bot: audit.kms: key=projects/ri/locations/global/key-rbac-v2 rotate by svc-account key-rotator@infra at 2026-07-02T02:10Z. Some older objects still encrypted with projects/ri/locations/global/keyRbac.

infra-bot: migrator run id=mig-20260702-07 started at 2026-07-02T02:30Z by rbac-migrator@infra.

mona: Check KMS decrypt errors during migrator: were there any transient DENYs or key-not-found?

kms-bot: KMS logs: during mig-20260702-07 at 02:31:12Z..02:31:28Z there are multiple `DECRYPT_FAILED` entries for resource=rbac_roles.encrypted_alias with key=projects/ri/locations/global/keyRbac (old key name). Error: `KEY_NOT_FOUND` for attempts abc-998..abc-1001. Migrator retried but those specific rows were written back blank by the job.

hugo: That explains it — alias decryption failed for some project-scoped rows and migrator wrote empty alias -> project-level perms became explicit-empty instead of inheriting org. For admin flows we rely on keys:rotate being present via alias expansion.

eli: Query I ran to find affected orgs: `SELECT org_id, count(*) FROM rbac_roles WHERE (role_alias IS NULL OR role_alias = '') AND resource_type='project' GROUP BY org_id HAVING count(*)>0;` -> returned org-321, org-402, org-519.

sec-oncall: Impact P2 (customer-facing admin UX). Low direct security impact because we didn't grant extra perms, but admins are blocked from rotation operations. Need incident with audit and remediation plan.

frontend: Immediate short-term mitigation: I'll make the Console fall back to org-level permissions for key rotation endpoints when project perms empty, behind feature flag `ui.rbac.org-fallback-rotate`. That avoids 403 for admins while we fix DB. Also show tooltip: "Using org-level admin permission".

mona: Good. Also we need to re-run migrator with KMS compatibility for rotated keys and a migration-time key mapping table so we don't lose aliases encrypted with retired key names. Plan: 1) add migration-time mapping to try old key id if decrypt fails, 2) backfill blank aliases from org-level alias when safe, 3) capture a list of affected orgs and attach to INC-20260702-11.

hugo: I'll requeue migrator for those orgs with run_id=mig-20260702-07-retry and verbose KMS logs. Also temporarily grant rbac-migrator service account access to old key name to allow decryption (short window).

infra-bot: job queued: migrator-reconcile org=org-321,org-402,org-519 run_id=mig-20260702-07-retry verbose=true (eta ~2m).

eli: Safe backfill SQL (only run if migrator retry fails):
```
-- idempotent: only add missing perm
UPDATE rbac_roles
SET permissions = array_append(permissions, 'keys:rotate')
WHERE org_id = 'org-321' AND resource_type='project' AND role_alias IN ('admin') AND NOT (permissions @> ARRAY['keys:rotate']);
```

sec-oncall: We should avoid blind DB updates; prefer re-run migrator+KMS grants. DB fallback only as last resort and must be audited.

mona: Infra granted temporary decrypt rights to rbac-migrator@infra on old key at 2026-07-02T02:44Z and kicked the retry. Logs streaming -> https://logs.redwood.ai/mig-20260702-07-retry

infra-bot: migrator run mig-20260702-07-retry started at 2026-07-02T02:46Z.

hugo: Update: migrator completed at 2026-07-02T03:02Z. Post-run check: `SELECT state FROM rbac_migration WHERE org_id='org-321'` -> `complete`. Re-run permission checks: project perms now inherit admin alias and show `keys:rotate`.

frontend: Frontend flag `ui.rbac.org-fallback-rotate` toggled off for org-321, telemetry showed 2 fallbacks while disabled. Tooltip impressions recorded as `rbac.ui.fallback_rotate` counter.

sec-oncall: Closing immediate incident. Follow-ups: 1) add migrator KMS-key-mapping fallback so decryption tries previous key ids, 2) lint migrations touching encrypted columns to ensure KMS grants present during rollout, 3) add a post-migration check to detect empty aliases and alert if any exist >1m, 4) add CI test simulating KMS key rotation during migration. Assigned owners in INC-20260702-11.

el i: I'll document the safe backfill SQL and keep it as last-resort step in the runbook. Thanks team. :lock:
